'''Mowa Gundeeb''' was the [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] of the ''[[Jedi Dreamer]]''.

==Biography==
Gundeeb grew bored of life on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] and used his talents at combat to leave at a young age and join a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group. He was nearly killed when his group was ambushed by a rival gang of mercenaries. He ejected in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and would have been killed if not for the timely arrival of a patrol of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] that drove off the hostiles. Gundeeb felt he had a debt to [[Korren Starchaser]] who was leading the patrol, and joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel alliance]].<ref name="AJ6" />

==Personality and traits==
Gundeeb was unusual for a Sullustan in that he was quiet with no sense of humor. He was a competent [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and had an interest in non-[[Human/Legends|human]] philosophy.<ref name="AJ6" />
